name: GoldCoin Health Foods Limited
summary: Goldcoin Health Foods Ltd. is an enterprise focused on the processing, trade, import, and export of fruits, vegetables, and dairy products. Their operations encompass a variety of preservation methods, including dehydration, canning, drying, and freezing, and they also offer consultancy services in these areas. Furthermore, the company engages in the production of raw milk, which serves as a vital raw material for dairies producing milk and milk products. This Indian firm, headquartered in Ahmedabad, was founded on March 27, 1989.
